list.description: Read the work your students have sent and give them feedback.

queue.oldestFirst: Oldest first, so nobody waits too long.
queue.truncated: Showing the {count, number} oldest submissions. Review some to see the rest.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.description: When students in your classes send work, it appears here.

noClasses.title: You have no classes yet
noClasses.description: Create a class and assign a course: your students’ projects will appear here.

empty.title: No submissions in this class yet
empty.description: Work that the students of this class send will appear here.

all.staleCursor: This page link is out of date.

brief.title: What the student was asked to do
brief.unavailable: The instructions for this work are not available to you.

ai.title: AI suggestion
ai.label: AI-generated
ai.disclaimer: A suggestion only: you decide the grade and the feedback.

flags.title: Points to check
flags.possible_personal_data: May contain personal information, such as a name, an email address or a phone number.
flags.unsafe_content: May contain content that is not safe.
flags.possible_plagiarism: May be copied from somewhere else.
flags.possible_prompt_injection: Seems to talk to the AI reviewer instead of doing the work.
flags.blocksApprove: A suggestion with points to check cannot be approved as it is.

ai.writtenFeedback: Suggested feedback for the student ({locale, select, en {in English} fr {in French} other {in another language}})
ai.limitations: What the AI could not check

pending.title: The AI suggestion is being prepared
pending.description: It usually takes less than a minute.
pending.still: The AI suggestion is still being prepared.

failed.title: No AI suggestion
failed.generic: The AI could not produce a suggestion.

reasons.incomplete: The AI’s answer was cut off.
reasons.refused: The AI declined to review this work.
reasons.blocked: The AI’s answer was blocked by the safety check.
reasons.invalid_output: The AI’s answer could not be read.
reasons.provider_error: The AI service did not answer.

skipped.title: No AI suggestion
skipped.description: The student’s daily limit of AI reviews was reached, or AI is turned off for the school.

ai.none: There is no AI suggestion for this work.
ai.noRegenerations: No new suggestion can be asked for this work.
ai.regenerateConflict: No new suggestion can be asked now. The page has been refreshed.

form.title: Your decision

approve.label: Approve the AI suggestion
approve.description: The suggested scores become the grade.

modify.label: Grade with my own scores
modify.description: Give a score from 0 to 100 for each criterion.

return.label: Return for changes
return.description: No grade. The student improves the work and sends it again.

approveBlocked.not_ready: Available once the AI suggestion is ready.
approveBlocked.unavailable: There is no AI suggestion to approve.
approveBlocked.flagged: The AI suggestion has points to check, so it cannot be approved as it is.
approveBlocked.low_confidence: The AI is not confident about its suggestion, so it cannot be approved as it is.

form.scorePending: Fill in every score to see the total.
form.scoreInvalid: Correct the scores to see the total.

feedback.label: Feedback for the student
feedback.hint: The student reads this. Say what went well and what to improve. Up to {max, number} characters.
feedback.useAi: Start from the AI’s suggested feedback

errors.form: Check the decision and try again.
errors.conflict: This work has changed: another teacher may have reviewed it, or the AI suggestion changed. The page has been refreshed.
errors.notFound: This work is no longer in your classes. The page has been refreshed.
errors.sessionEnded: Your feedback is still here. Log in again in a new tab, then come back and send it.
